symptoms.storage_claim_pending: A volume claim is not bound.
symptoms.node_unhealthy: The node is in a bad state.
symptoms.service_no_endpoints: The Service has no working endpoints.

facts.pvc_lost: Claim {pvc} is in phase {phase}: the volume it was bound to no longer exists.
facts.pvc_missing: A Pod mounts claim {pvc}, but the claim does not exist.
facts.storage_class_missing: Claim {pvc} asks for StorageClass {class}, which does not exist.
facts.storage_default_class_missing: Claim {pvc} names no StorageClass, and the cluster has no default one.
facts.service_selector: Service {service} selects Pods with the labels {selector}, and no Pod matches them.
facts.service_endpoints_not_ready: Service {service} has {total} endpoint addresses, {ready} of them ready.
facts.service_no_endpoint_slices: Service {service} has Pods, but no EndpointSlice was found for it.
facts.service_port_mismatch: Service {service} sends port {port} to targetPort {target}, which no container of the selected Pods declares.
facts.node_condition: Node {node} reports the condition {condition} with status {status}.
facts.node_pods_unready: {unready} of {total} Pods on node {node} are not ready.
facts.node_cordoned: Node {node} is closed to new Pods (spec.unschedulable).

hypotheses.pvc_missing: Claim {pvc} does not exist, so Pods that mount it cannot start.
hypotheses.pvc_lost: The volume behind claim {pvc} is gone, so the claim is Lost.
hypotheses.pvc_unbound: Claim {pvc} is not bound to a volume, and no more specific cause was found.
hypotheses.storage_class_not_found: Claim {pvc} asks for StorageClass {class}, which does not exist, so no volume can be provisioned.
hypotheses.storage_no_default_class: Claim {pvc} names no StorageClass and the cluster has no default one, so no volume is provisioned.
hypotheses.storage_waiting_first_consumer: Claim {pvc} binds only when a Pod uses it, and no Pod does.
hypotheses.storage_provisioning_failed: The volume provisioner failed to create a volume for claim {pvc}.
hypotheses.service_selector_no_match: The selector of Service {service} matches no Pod, so the Service has no endpoints.
hypotheses.service_no_ready_endpoints: None of the endpoints of Service {service} is ready, so it receives no traffic.
hypotheses.service_no_endpoints: Service {service} has no EndpointSlice yet; the endpoints controller may still be catching up.
hypotheses.service_target_port_mismatch: Port {port} of Service {service} may point to targetPort {target}, which the selected Pods do not declare.
hypotheses.node_not_ready: Node {node} is not ready (status {status}), so Pods on it may be unavailable.
hypotheses.node_pressure_memory: Node {node} is under memory pressure, so Pods on it may be evicted or killed.
hypotheses.node_pressure_disk: Node {node} is under disk pressure, so Pods on it may be evicted.
hypotheses.node_pressure_pid: Node {node} is under process limit pressure, so new processes may fail to start.
hypotheses.node_network_unavailable: The network of node {node} is not configured, so Pods on it may be unreachable.
hypotheses.node_unschedulable: Node {node} is closed to new Pods, which may be deliberate (cordon).

recommendations.rec_create_missing_claim: Create PersistentVolumeClaim {pvc}, or correct the claim name in the Pod spec.
recommendations.rec_restore_volume: Recover or recreate the volume that claim {pvc} was bound to, or create a new claim.
recommendations.rec_fix_storage_class: Create StorageClass {class}, or point claim {pvc} to an existing one.
recommendations.rec_set_default_storage_class: Mark a StorageClass as the default, or name one in claim {pvc}.
recommendations.rec_use_or_delete_claim: Start a Pod that uses claim {pvc}, or delete the claim if it is no longer needed.
recommendations.rec_fix_service_selector: Make the selector of Service {service} match the labels of its Pods, or label the Pods accordingly.
recommendations.rec_check_pods_behind_service: Check why the Pods behind Service {service} are not ready.
recommendations.rec_fix_service_port: Make targetPort {target} of Service {service} match a port the container listens on.
recommendations.rec_check_node: Check the state of node {node}: kubelet, network and the node's events.
recommendations.rec_relieve_node: Free resources on node {node} or move workloads away from it.
recommendations.rec_uncordon_node: If the maintenance on node {node} is over, make it schedulable again (uncordon).

steps.step_check_provisioner: Check the volume provisioner's logs and the events of claim {pvc}.

missing.service_selector_missing: The Service has no selector, so it does not choose any Pods.
missing.graph_unavailable: The dependency graph could not be built ({reason}).

graphReasons.oom_killed: Killed for running out of memory
